youtube_description:
Welcome to the Neural Relay Race—an ultra-futuristic ML competition where teams pass model checkpoints like batons and race for real-time accuracy under shifting track conditions. 

In this visualization, we track: 
• Accuracy (top-line performance) 
• Latency (speed to decision) 
• Robustness (performance under noise/shift) 
• Calibration (confidence that matches reality) 

Comment your predicted winner and watch the leaderboard evolve lap by lap!
